company: GWAM Asia (Global Wealth and Asset Management)
industry: Financial Services - Asset Management, Wealth & Retirement Technology
role_summary: Senior technology strategy and architecture leadership role for GWAM Asia, acting as Chief Architect across applications, platforms, data, integration, cloud, and AI. Leads the Local Architecture Review Board (LARB), drives responsible AI adoption, defines shared technology service capabilities across Asia markets, and may oversee Asia operations technology. Requires strong stakeholder influence across global, regional, and market technology and business leaders.
must_have_requirements: University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
Strong enterprise/solution/application architecture experience spanning data, integration, cloud, and security
Demonstrated experience leading architecture governance forums (e.g., ARB/LARB) and making risk-balanced technology decisions
Practical experience applying AI in business/technology contexts, including AI application delivery, agent deployment, or AI-enabled workflow transformation
Strong knowledge of SDLC in the AI era, including AI-assisted engineering, model/agent lifecycle, responsible AI controls, testing, monitoring, and production readiness
Experience defining and driving shared technology services, reusable platforms, and engineering standards across multiple markets or business lines
Proven senior stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills across business, technology, risk, and operations partners
Experience translating global technology strategy into regional/market-specific technology roadmaps
Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth, or retirement technology environments (preferred/likely required)
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience overseeing operations technology capabilities (production stability, resilience, business continuity)
Experience coaching/mentoring architects and technology leaders to build AI-enabled capability
Experience with regulatory/compliance considerations in APAC financial markets
Exposure to cloud-native architecture and modern engineering practices (DevOps, microservices, APIs)
Experience with data governance and AI-ready data architecture
Background working within global matrixed organizations (Global vs Regional vs Market technology teams)
soft_skills_priority: Facilitation and governance leadership (running architecture boards)
Conflict resolution and negotiation across competing priorities
Storytelling and communication to senior leaders

scoring_criteria.name: Chief/Enterprise Architecture Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core identity of the role - must have led architecture at senior/enterprise level
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have solution architect title but not 'Chief Architect' explicitly

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Governance (LARB/ARB experience)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role explicitly requires leading a Local Architecture Review Board and governance decision-making

scoring_criteria.name: AI Adoption & Responsible AI Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Heavy emphasis on practical AI adoption, agent-based solutions, and responsible AI controls
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have general AI exposure but not agent-based or governance-specific experience

scoring_criteria.name: Shared Technology Services & Reusable Platforms
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Key accountability to reduce duplication and build reusable capabilities across markets

scoring_criteria.name: Operations Technology Oversight
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role may include oversight of Asia ops tech ensuring stability and resilience
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidate may be architecture-only without direct ops oversight

scoring_criteria.name: Financial Services / Asset Management Domain Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: GWAM context requires familiarity with asset/wealth/retirement business technology
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May come from adjacent financial services (banking) rather than asset management specifically

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud, Data & Integration Architecture Depth
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Architecture leadership spans cloud, data, integration domains

scoring_criteria.name: Senior Stakeholder Management & Influence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires influencing without formal authority across global/regional/market stakeholders

scoring_criteria.name: Regional/Global Matrix Experience (Asia + Global alignment)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role bridges global strategy with Asia market realities

scoring_criteria.name: Talent Coaching & Team Development
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Accountable for building future-ready architect talent and AI confidence

summary_focus: Position as senior architecture leader with enterprise/chief architect-level scope
Highlight AI adoption experience including agent-based or AI-enabled workflow delivery
Emphasize architecture governance leadership (ARB/design authority) and risk-balanced decision-making
Showcase multi-market or regional technology leadership bridging global strategy to local execution
Include financial services or asset/wealth management domain relevance if applicable
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim 'Chief Architect' title if only held solution/enterprise architect roles - clarify scope instead
Do not overstate AI agent deployment if only exposure was pilots/POCs - be specific about maturity level
Do not imply direct operations technology ownership if experience was advisory/oversight only
Do not claim asset management domain expertise if experience is purely banking/insurance-based without adaptation context

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Confident, strategic, and consultative - reflecting a senior architecture leader comfortable engaging executives and driving enterprise-wide change
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position candidate as a pragmatic architecture leader who bridges global strategy with regional execution, with hands-on credibility in AI adoption and governance rather than purely theoretical AI enthusiasm
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking formal 'Chief Architect' title, emphasize equivalent scope and governance authority held in prior roles
If asset/wealth management domain experience is limited, highlight transferable financial services architecture experience and quick domain ramp-up ability
If AI experience is more advisory than hands-on deployment, frame as strategic AI enablement and governance leadership rather than technical AI engineering
If operations technology oversight is indirect, position as strong collaboration with ops teams rather than direct ownership
